<b>Bone Bottom Repairs</b> is a [[Donate Wishes|Donate Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>, found on the Wishwall in [[Bone Bottom]].

== Wish ==
To complete the Wish, donate {{S|200}} to the Bone Bottom Wishwall. <i>Bone Bottom Repairs</i> is a prerequisite Wish required to unlock the <i>[[A Lifesaving Bridge]]</i> and <i>[[Silk and Soul]]</i> Wishes.
